title: Compute brief — 21 September 2026
description: PUCT stamps Order Adopting 16 TAC §25.194 ($50k/MW, ≥75 MW) and files the Howard–Solstice 765 kV written Order; CleanSpark prices $2.276B notes for Meta’s Sandersville campus. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 69 confirms, 0 ticks.
og_kicker: PUCT §25.194 adopted; 59336 Order filed; CLSK notes priced
lede: Texas’s permanent large-load rule is no longer a draft. On Friday 18 Sep PUCT filed Order Adopting new 16 TAC §25.194 (Interchange 58481 item 218): before an ERCOT interconnection study, ≥75 MW customers must disclose and post $50,000/MW financial security, then execute an SLLIA with further security and CIAC. Same-day item 219 acknowledges Texas Register receipt (TRD 202604027) for the 10/02/2026 issue; Interchange lists effectiveness 10.08.2026. Also Friday, Docket 59336 item 2741 dropped the written Order approving Howard–Solstice along Route 4 mod 1 (~$2.15B estimated line cost), stamping the 11 Sep vote. CleanSpark’s 8-K Exhibit 99.1 priced $2.276B of 7.875% senior notes due 2031 at 98.500% (upsized from the 17 Sep $2.227B proposal) to finish the Meta/Anviran 175 MW Sandersville campus — close targeted 25 Sep. The Silicon Tape is another clean Monday confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.
